bullets: description: A full-length paper grounded in original data or the literature that takes a policy position or proposes a new policy, with an unstructured abstract.
limits: body up to 4,000 words (The word count limitation does not include references)
limits: unstructured abstract up to 200 words
limits: title up to 100 characters including spaces
components: the venue names no sections for this type — write into the manuscript's own, and the journal's structure follows what you write

components: disclosures — a concise summary of every author's declared conflicts in the manuscript; any AI use disclosed in the Methods or Acknowledgements; data and code sources cited in the reference list.
components: cover letter — an explanation of how the submission differs from any related preprint, dissertation or paper, any use of AI tools, and any reviewers to exclude with a brief reason
format: titles up to 100 characters including spaces.
format: related published papers are cited as endnotes; the journal's own page gives the reference style — confirm there.
format: every author's conflicts of interest are declared on the cover page; a signed ICMJE disclosure form for each author by the latest revision.
format: the Methods state ethics approval (or that it was not required) and written informed consent; identifying information is anonymised.
